title: Work Labels: keep the reading position when returning from Memories
outcome: With a task selected in Labels, switching to Memories and returning preserves the saved viewport position, including when the title is above the viewport and the user is reading the details.
acceptance: A Work panel behavior test selects a Labels task, scrolls away from its title to read details, switches to Memories and back, and verifies the prior scroll offset is restored.
Returning to Labels from a different task view still reveals an out-of-view selected task without moving focus from the view switch, and the Memories round trip reuses the same task list.
